WHY ASLI

Streetwear's oldest question is real vs fake. Fast fashion prints a lakh copies of the same tee — ASLI prints exactly one: yours. Every piece is designed by its wearer and printed on demand in India. अपना डिज़ाइन। असली तुम।

QUESTIONS

Is the AI generation really free?+

Yes. Artwork is generated with Pollinations.ai, which is free and needs no API key. You can generate and regenerate as much as you like before ordering.

How does my design get printed?+

Orders are fulfilled print-on-demand in India — each piece is printed only after you order it, then shipped to your door. No inventory, no bulk orders.

Can I put Hindi text on my garment?+

Yes. The text layer supports Devanagari with a proper Hindi typeface, plus display and mono fonts. Type it, position it, done.

Who owns the design I create?+

You do. Anything you generate in the studio is yours to wear, gift, or sell.

How much does a custom piece cost?+

Custom tees are ₹949 and hoodies ₹1,299 — the AI design work is included free.
